set.body:
Outcome
Make docking compatibility an early visual and behavioral acceptance gate.

Owned scope
adapter; sampler vertical slice; provider acceptance receipt

Prerequisites
B0, B1, B2, B3

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] B0 accepts a reviewed exact ScalaDock revision through the declared consumer checks.
- [ ] B1/B2 deliver a functioning docked workspace and detached inspector in all four appearance/density variants.
- [ ] B3 independently accepts the native hierarchy, density, focus and window/overlay consistency before broad catalog expansion.

Required evidence
B0 provider receipt, B3 native review and interaction evidence.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code E1. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [E1] Prove Meridian on a real ScalaDock workspace
